description: A bright, open-plan contemporary kitchen bathed in cool natural daylight streaming through a large picture window on the left wall. A stainless steel undermount sink with a brushed-nickel arc-neck faucet is set into the perimeter counter. A black gas cooktop is visible at the far right edge. A large kitchen island with a thick waterfall quartz or engineered stone top in the same pale marble finish occupies the foreground center. On the island surface sits a round wooden bowl filled with bright green pears, a wooden utensil holder, and a faucet set into the island's sink. A white ceramic vase with a loose arrangement of fresh flowers sits on the perimeter counter near the sink. A glimpse of a gray sofa with textured throw pillows is visible through the open-plan passthrough at the left, beyond the large window that frames a sunny garden with a warm wood privacy fence. The camera is at standing eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, with a wide lens. The composition is a wide three-quarter corner view capturing both the island and the perimeter wall with the full depth of the open-plan space.
